Package io.telekom.orchest.adapter.kafka

Class DynamicKafkaConsumerFactory<T>

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.adapter.kafka.DynamicKafkaConsumerFactory<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of the event payload.
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.context.Lifecycle, org.springframework.context.Phased, org.springframework.context.SmartLifecycle
public class DynamicKafkaConsumerFactory<T> extends Object implements org.springframework.context.SmartLifecycle
Factory for creating and managing dynamic Kafka consumers. Allows registering consumers for topics at runtime, supporting encrypted messages. Implements SmartLifecycle to manage the lifecycle of the consumers.

  • Method Details

    • registerWorkerConsumer

      public void registerWorkerConsumer(String topicName, String groupId, int concurrency)
      Registers and starts a new Kafka consumer for the specified topic. Uses the groupId as both the consumer group ID and bean name.
      Parameters:
      topicName - The name of the topic to consume from.
      groupId - The consumer group ID (also used as bean name).
      concurrency - The number of concurrent consumers.

    • registerWorkerConsumer

      public void registerWorkerConsumer(String topicName, String groupId, String beanName, int concurrency)
      Registers and starts a new Kafka consumer for the specified topic with an explicit group ID.
      Parameters:
      topicName - The name of the topic to consume from.
      groupId - The consumer group ID (optional; when null, uses factory default).
      beanName - The bean name for the listener container.
      concurrency - The number of concurrent consumers.

    • stopConsumer

      public void stopConsumer(String topicName)
      Stops and removes the consumer(s) for the specified topic.
      Parameters:
      topicName - The name of the topic.
